scope: Actual per-capture resource access and independent address capability checks in the finite synchronous182 profile, including repaired FnMut environment reborrow.
review_notes: Resource description provenance no longer depends on unrelated module-wide head syntax.
Capture slot maps are reconstructed from raw MakeClosure inputs and ordinary local/SSA propagation, preserving each source and finite fixed-point growth.
Actual Desc accesses come from independently checked CFG and caller substitution; helper writes remains its declared upper bound and callback traces are independently verified.
Environment position loans stay separate from captured external Address capabilities. Reborrowing a mutable environment cannot turn readonly Desc capture into write authority.
Current callback captures and explicit arguments participate in the invocation even at last use.
Factories and retained fields are admitted only under the separately checked self-contained environment profile; raw Address<Closure> capture remains explicitly closed.
Each new relation copy, traversal and fixed-point growth charges the existing bounded verifier budget; no default budget changes.

cases: Mutable independent n plus read-only resource head through FnMut helper; nearest body adds resource write and must reject.
Two ordinary headless forwarding layers keep actual aliased Desc target; disjoint target succeeds, alias rejects.
Adding an unrelated unused function that reads a resource head cannot change the source rejection.
Moved shared field capture remains read-only through two borrowed helper calls.

finding_and_repair.finding: The ReborrowAddress access check still used aggregate Hold roots, so &mut F incorrectly treated a readonly captured resource as a mutable target and rejected a safe program.
finding_and_repair.repair: Only actual environment position loans qualify an Address<Closure> reborrow. External capture loans keep their previous permissions; actual Call effects and source conflicts are still checked.

boundaries: Explicit Address callback parameters, retained borrowed nested environments and ByteBuffer Desc captures remain outside this finite profile.
No complete concurrency, async, lending, dynamic dispatch or full1.4 claim.
